BEFORE YOU EMPTY YOUR CLOSET

A few loose threads.

New idea. Fair questions.

Can I use my own clothes?

That’s the whole idea! Your bag is intended to use your own approved clothes. Colours and patterns depend on the material you send. Choose an existing design as a starting point or describe your own.

Which clothes are suitable?

Start with clean, dry, untorn denim, cotton or another sturdy woven fabric. Avoid mould, heavy stains, brittle fabric and very stretchy or delicate materials. Photos help, but a maker must inspect the fabric before confirming suitability and how much is needed.

How do I hand over the clothes?

Pickup and drop-off are planned options, subject to the launch location and availability. This prototype does not arrange a courier or collect an address. You can select a preference in your sample request.

What am I paying for?

The planned making fee covers work such as cutting, stitching, lining and standard hardware. Custom work and delivery may cost extra. All prices here are illustrative; a final quote needs your approval before any payment or cutting.

Can I actually order a bag here yet?

This is an interactive concept prototype. You can customize a design and save or download a sample request on this device. Nothing is sent to a maker, no payment is taken, and no pickup or delivery is booked.
